title: Fix namespace, HTTP content-length, and BridgeApp structural issues
description:
## Source
SonarQube static analysis audit (`Data/Pages/audits/ms-sonar-static-analysis-7-26-26.md`)

## Findings
1. `MemorySmith.Bridge/Program.cs` (L9) — `BridgeApp` class declared without a namespace, causing type conflicts
2. `MemorySmith.App/Components/Pages/Pages.razor` (L795) — HTTP request without content-length limit, risking resource exhaustion
3. `MemorySmith.App/Services/MemorySmithOptions.cs` (L452) — TODO that should be completed or tracked

## Action Required
1. Wrap `BridgeApp` in appropriate namespace declaration
2. Add `MaxResponseContentBufferSize` or set `WebRequest.ContentLength` in Pages.razor
3. Review and resolve the TODO in MemorySmithOptions.cs

## Effort
~30min

## Priority
P0 — Bug/Security

comments.author: anonymous
comments.body: 2026-08-08 deep-dive found BridgeApp still accepts valid non-object JSON as empty arguments and silently falls back to the default endpoint after malformed .vscode/mcp.json. Add explicit validation and source/reason diagnostics rather than treating malformed configuration as success.
